subject: brooktail_captain

authorization: Owner standing direction 1 (15 Oct 2026): Meshy, no generation cap; candidate stays flag-off until its scene passes judging. CLAUDE.md art rule (agent-drafted reference, identity kept).
disposition: Meshy multi-image-to-3D mesh from the Fights lane's prop batch, rigged on the project's 15-bone quadruped skeleton (same bone names and hierarchy as the installed creature_brooktail_lod0.glb, minus its unused neutral_bone) with the installed six clip names plus charged/rest/swim. Flag-off: installed creature_brooktail_lod0.glb, species.json and trainers.json are unchanged.

rig.derived_from: assets/creatures/tetherbound/staticub/candidate_regen/source/ (47267739b, 3f0f0eea5) via the Stormursa v3 / Burrowback multiview scripts
rig.skeleton: 15-bone quadruped: root, pelvis, spine, neck, head, front_upper/lower_l/r, rear_upper/lower_l/r, tail_1, tail_2
rig.installed_skeleton_match: same 15 bone names and parents as creature_brooktail_lod0.glb (installed also carries an unweighted neutral_bone)
rig.clip_frames_note: frame counts at 24 fps; attack paws return to the ground at t=0.65 (frame ~16 of 24), so the existing f22_hero_model_attack_contact_phase 0.652174 matches
otter_specific_changes: paddle tail on the ground is excluded before measuring leg columns; front/rear pairs split at the largest foot-band gap
head = volume above the measured chin line (0.70 of height) in front of the leg gap; throat/chest band below it is the neck
tail bones follow the measured on-ground tail centreline
rig.rigid_parts: Harness, sash, brass buckle and rope wraps are surface detail on one welded skin (no separate parts). The chest band is spine/neck weighted and no clip animates the neck, so it moves as one piece; rope wraps sit inside the rigid lower-leg regions.

scale.basis: installed Brooktail species.json placeholder.height 2.10 m (creature_body._fit fits the model to height x body_scale at load; footprint allowance 0.722 x 2 x 8.6 = 12.4 m does not clamp)
scale.boss_size: applied in game by the trainer member row's body_scale (Fights lane captures used 1.6, 1.9 and 2.3); e.g. 1.5 gives 3.15 m tall, 6.2 m long
scale.never_shrink: 2.10 m head height is above the 1.80 m trainer at body_scale 1.0; length follows the uniform scale (no length squash)

pose_check: Blender pose_check.py idle/walk/run/attack/hit/faint inspected: clean deformation, no tearing, harness and rope wraps intact; sheet kept local (not committed)
visual_verdict_raw: Accept as candidate: identity held (chocolate-brown/cream otter, blue eyes, broad flat dark scaled paddle tail, clawed paws), teal sash harness with brass rivets and chest buckle, rope wraps on forearms, confident head-high quadruped stance with all four legs separated; no red.
activation: Requires the F22#4 in-world Riverwatch capture and three code-blind judges at Bar A 7.5 (CPU-provisional 6.7); set f22_hero_model_preview true with f22_hero_model_path pointing here and f22_hero_model_length_scale 1.0
